titleAr: اشتري إضافة أو فعّل ميزة خارج باقتي
titleEn: Buy an add-on outside my plan

undo.note: a payment is not refunded automatically; cancel stops the renewal and the add-on stays on until the paid term ends

en: How do I turn on a feature that is not in my plan?
How do I buy an add-on?

steps: Press Buy on the add-on and read the exact total
Press Yes, charge and pay by card on the hosted page
The add-on turns on by itself when the payment is confirmed
edgeCases: Owner only: staff are refused; the store id comes from the path
One payment grants one 30 day term, exactly once, even if the payment confirmation arrives twice
A declined or abandoned payment grants nothing and charges nothing
The preview and the confirm state the renewal (amount, every 30 days, how to stop it); an email goes out before each renewal
Cancel stops the renewal; access stays until the paid term ends; cancel and resume are appended as ledger rows
A renewal is NOT charged, and the owner is told, when the price changed, the plan now includes the feature, support switched it off, or there is no saved card
A feature that support switched off cannot be bought
A feature the plan already includes is not sold again
A super admin can still switch any feature on or off for goodwill; that override wins over a purchase

Each add-on shows one state from the ledger: available, waiting for payment, payment failed, active/renewing, ends soon (cancelled at period end), ended, refunded, in your plan, or turned on by support
The page asks the server after the card page and never turns anything on in the browser; a pending payment grants nothing
A locked screen for a sellable feature offers Get this add-on (the Add-ons page), not Contact support
The cached entitlement expires at the paid term end (not on a 5 minute TTL); a daily run also clears every cache layer for stores whose term ended
Receipts and payment history (paid, waiting, failed, refunded) are listed on the page; no provider fields

InstaPay: the merchant transfers the quoted total and uploads the receipt; that opens an entry in the existing super-admin claims queue and the add-on stays OFF until a super admin approves it (approve-addon); reject or silence leaves nothing active; a pending InstaPay claim blocks a second purchase of the same add-on
Refunds stay a super-admin action; there is no merchant self-refund
The AI packs show a credits meter: requests left today, what used them (from the AI usage ledger) and each running pack with its end date
gaps: Refunding the earlier of two stacked terms does not pull the later term forward
assistantNote: assistant says plan/override cause and links billing; cannot enable
